elaine (support): FYI escalating from Acme — their ingestion pipeline started throwing JSON parse errors after a weekend spike. They say we returned invalid JSON from JSON mode (trailing commas + stray text). They need a repro and better observability. Request IDs included: rw-req-9f3a / rw-req-9f3b.

maria (eng-ml): thanks, can you paste the exact model + config they used? json_mode setting, schema used, and sample prompt?

elaine (support): they call the hosted API: model=redwood-open-13b-v1, decoder=json_strict, prompt version=v2.1. Repro steps from customer: 1) POST /v1/generate with json schema payload; 2) get 200 but body contains: 
```
{"user_id":"123","items":[{"id":1,},]}
unexpected text: "NOTE: summary clipped"
```
They see downstream parser crash in their kafka consumer. Happened ~2025-11-21 03:12 UTC during a retry storm.

tom (prod-eng): ouch. that trailing comma + appended note points to post-processing or model continuing outside of schema. Could be model drift or changed temperature/stop sequences. Any rate-limited or retry behaviour in the logs?

elaine (support): customer reports multiple 429 retries from their side; but our ingress logs show single successful response for rw-req-9f3a. Attached snippet from our access log: `200 GET /v1/generate rw-req-9f3a model=redwood-open-13b-v1 latency=312ms tokens=128`. No obvious error.

maria (eng-ml): can you dump the raw model output from that request? We redact PII but need the text token stream to debug if the model appended an explanatory note. We should also check which kernel and quantization profile served the request (might affect decoding).

elaine (support): pasted raw output below (redacted customer content):
```
{"user_id":"123","items":[{"id":1}],"summary":"Order OK"}
\nNOTE: customer used old schema v1; migrated prefix added by prompt manager: "Ensure compatibility with older schema v1"
```
I removed their emails.

raj (sre): we need tracing/metrics for this class of failures: json_parse_failures{model,route,decoder}, and a sampled raw-output capture keyed by x-rw-request-id. We currently capture response body in debug logs only, not correlated to request id in traces. Add a span tag `json.mode` and `decoder` in the trace.

tom (prod-eng): agree. Suggested immediate mitigations: 
- add a counter metric: `structured_output.invalid_json` with labels model, decoder, route, environment
- for sampled failures (1 in 1000), persist raw output + request id into S3 (redacted) for offline triage
- ensure we include `x-rw-request-id` in console and debug logs so support can fetch samples quickly

maria (eng-ml): one nuance: we have two decoding layers — the model-facing tokenizer output and our post-processing sanitizer that enforces schema. The sanitizer sometimes silently fixes small issues (e.g., unescaped quotes). If sanitizer is disabled or buggy during bursts, we might return raw model text. Need to check rollout flags that touched `schema_sanitizer_v2`.

elaine (support): customer says they saw the exact note string after we rolled some config last week. I'll attach config snapshot from their tenant: `schema_sanitizer_v2: off`, `allow_incomplete_items: true`.

raj (sre): actionable items for observability: 
1) instrument `json.mode` and `schema_sanitizer` as trace attributes on request entry.
2) emit `structured_output.invalid_json` metric with request_id as a tag (or hashed id) so we can backtrace.
3) add a short-lived log index (48h retention) that stores redacted raw_output + request_id + model + decoder for sampled failures.

infra-bot: deploy pipeline note — a canary for `schema_sanitizer_v2` rollout is scheduled for 2025-11-22T02:00Z.

maria (eng-ml): for debugging right now I'll: 
- replay rw-req-9f3a against a deterministic server with `schema_sanitizer_v2` toggled on/off to repro.
- add assertion tests to the sanitizer that fail early and emit structured error objects instead of free text.

tom (prod-eng): I'll create a Grafana dashboard panel: time series of `structured_output.invalid_json` and per-model breakdown, and an alert if rate > 5/min sustained for 5m. Also a log link to sampled raw outputs.

elaine (support): I've replied to the customer with a short triage note and asked for consent to store redacted outputs for debugging. They agreed.

maria (eng-ml): found an early hypothesis: when `allow_incomplete_items=true` the sanitizer may patch by trimming trailing tokens instead of failing, and we accidentally returned both patched JSON + the model's continuation note as plain text. Fix will be to return a single structured error with a `corrections` array that we can surface as structured metadata (not appended text).

raj (sre): timeline / owners: 
- tom: create dashboard + metric (ETA 4h)
- maria: repro + sanitizer assertion (ETA 6h)
- raj: tracing + sampled storage path (ETA 8h)
- elaine: coordinate customer comms and escalate if more customers see this (ongoing)

deploy-bot: deployment started for canary `schema-sanitizer-v2` in prod us-east-1 (canary id cs-773).

elaine (support): thanks team — I'll keep the thread updated. If anyone finds a quick mitigation to stop returning appended free text, flag it here and I'll push the change to the on-call runbook. :thumbsup:

maria (eng-ml): will post a short repro gist and a sample unit test once I reproduce locally.

raj (sre): I'll add a short runbook snippet: how to fetch sampled raw-output for a request id: `aws s3 cp s3://rw-sampled-outputs/{hash(rw-req)}` and link that from support runbook.

elaine (support): closing loop for now — assigned ticket RW-3456 with the above owners. Follow-up scheduled in 24h.
